core_style.default_register: casual - speaks openly about personal experiences and feelings

core_style.rhythm: slow-deliberate - takes time to articulate thoughts clearly
core_style.two_registers: formal when discussing football and business; casual with friends and family

structural_patterns: poses a question then answers it immediately
builds a narrative around personal experiences

vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of pauses and 'you know' to emphasize points
